Howdy hey! I'm KaraKatt and I'll be dropping a little bit of crit today!

+ Line by line and general thoughts.
- ...

Questions I Have While Reading Through

Besides the SCP- foundation trying to seek out useful knowledge, I want to have a young scientist try to immortalize him or herself inside this book, by any means necessary. Furthermore, I do want to include an anomalous committee that oversees and verifies every broken record and their interaction with the researches is also a vital part of the story.

Hmm, I worry this may be trying to do too much. Like implementing an entire committee to do this one job mixed with the fact that a researcher is trying to immortalize themselves.

Final notes

Alright, I think this is interesting, but I don't think its entirely quite there yet. There isn't entirely a focus on what the SCP does (which isn't it just a book that keeps records of anything that has ever happened?) and kinda lacks in terms of a cohesive story to push the two idea's (story and SCP) together. My suggestion would be to think about what direction you want to take this, and run with it.

Good luck!

item.title: A multidimensional book about records
item.content:encoded:
A book containing all the records set by any entity in any dimension in all of existence.

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: Tale

Genre: Drama/Emotional, Comedy,

Page Layout: Standard

Elevator Pitch: The vehement struggle of the Foundation to obtain useful information out of the book amongst the limitless amount of entries inside of it and the downfall of knowing said information.

Central Narrative: Besides the SCP- foundation trying to seek out useful knowledge, I want to have a young scientist try to immortalize him or herself inside this book, by any means necessary. Furthermore, I do want to include an anomalous committee that oversees and verifies every broken record and their interaction with the researches is also a vital part of the story. The book itself has no other anomalous qualities then depicting the records.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: I think that the premise, of a record book in a world full of extremes, is an interesting idea and something which would draw a lot of attention, provided it is done in a sufficient manner. Many parallels to existing SCPs could be drawn as well.

After a lengthy discussion on the critters forum, I came to the conclusion, that this idea is better suited for a tale. It is just a revisited idea of an older idea of mine here is a link to it http://www.scpwiki.com/forum/t-13137282/scp-idea-a-multidimensional-book-about-records

Back then I had already received one greenlight for my idea, but I still ask for another review since some details have changed, especially since it is not an SCP anymore.
